component.name: Masthead
component.summary: System statistics in the top bar

description.p: Masthead shows CPU, memory, GPU, network, disk and temperature readings in your desktop's top bar. Hover a reading for detail; click it for a window with history graphs, every sensor and the process table.
At rest it uses under 0.1% of one CPU core and writes nothing to disk. It works on GNOME, COSMIC, Waybar-based desktops, and any desktop with a system tray.
